_comment: Hand-placed coordinates for points the geocoder cannot resolve from the source descriptions. [lat, lon]. Keys are bike/ped point ids, PT section ids or railway station names. Edit and re-run `npm run etl` to correct a marker.

_why.RR_27: Promenada Krzycka between Bardzka and Ziebicka, by Cmentarz Ducha Swietego (approx. +-150 m)
